title_working: The Smallest Kid In School Just Jumped Over The Gym
world_rule: Nico can jump higher than any human, but promised his mum to keep it secret.
logline: The smallest kid in school breaks a promise to his mum to prove himself, and she smiles.

look.clothes: cyan T-shirt with a yellow lightning bolt, dark jeans, big red sneakers

locations: school field with bleachers, high-jump bar and mat, tall gym building with a flat roof

lines.text: The smallest kid in school just jumped over the gym.
lines.say: (confident) The smallest kid in school just jumped over the gym.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Extreme close-up of Nico's smirking face; flash cut to the gym roof high above.

lines.text: Ever since Nico was five, he could jump higher than any human alive.
lines.say: (calm) Ever since Nico was five, he could jump higher than any human alive.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Flashback (warm tint): little Nico hops onto a kitchen table, then up onto a high shelf.

lines.text: But he made one promise to his mum: never let anyone see.
lines.say: (calm)(soft tone) But he made one promise to his mum: never let anyone see.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up: his mum, serious, holds his shoulders; he nods slowly.

lines.text: At school, he was just the smallest kid in class, and everyone laughed at him.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) At school, he was just the smallest kid in class, and everyone laughed at him.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hallway: Nico walks alone, kids point and laugh around him.

lines.text: At the jump contest, everyone laughed when Nico stepped up to the mat.
lines.say: (calm) At the jump contest, everyone laughed when Nico stepped up to the mat.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Field wide: bleachers full, the crowd laughing; Nico tiny beside the tall bar.

lines.text: Chase, the star jumper, had won every year, and everyone knew he would win again.
lines.say: (nervous) Chase, the star jumper, had won every year, and everyone knew he would win again.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Chase flexes, low-angle close-up; the crowd chants his name.

lines.text: Everyone got one jump. Only one.
lines.say: (worried) Everyone got one jump. Only one.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Coach Reyes holds up one finger; a sign reads ONE JUMP ONLY.

lines.text: Chase flew over the bar. A new school record. The crowd went wild.
lines.say: (surprised) Chase flew over the bar. A new school record. The crowd went wild.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Chase soars over the bar (2.0 m on the board); the crowd erupts.

lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) Nico barely bent his knees.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Extreme close-up of Nico's sneakers on the mat; the cheering fades.

lines.text: Then the floor cracked under his feet.
lines.say: (nervous)(soft tone) Then the floor cracked under his feet.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Low angle: a crack spreads under Nico's shoes; a beat of silence.

lines.text: A second later, he was standing on the gym roof.
lines.say: (surprised) A second later, he was standing on the gym roof.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Camera tilts up fast to the sky; Nico lands on the roof, tiny against the sun.

lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) The whole school went silent.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Wide: a frozen crowd, mouths open; Chase's gold headband slips off.

lines.text: Coach Reyes measured it three times, sure her tape was broken.
lines.say: (surprised) Coach Reyes measured it three times, sure her tape was broken.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up of Coach Reyes with the tape; she shakes her head.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: The board reads 20.4 m; she lowers the tape slowly.

lines.text: Nico had just jumped ten times the school record.
lines.say: (surprised) Nico had just jumped ten times the school record.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Scoreboard: SCHOOL RECORD 2.0 m, NEW 20.4 m.

lines.text: And from that day on, everyone knew one thing.
lines.say: (calm)(soft tone) And from that day on, everyone knew one thing.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hallway: kids gather around Nico, smiling.

lines.text: Nico wasn't just the best jumper in school. He was the highest human alive.
lines.say: (confident) Nico wasn't just the best jumper in school. He was the highest human alive.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hero low-angle shot: Nico against the bright sky.

lines.text: And his promise to his mum? She was watching from the stands. She just smiled.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) And his promise to his mum? She was watching from the stands. She just smiled.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close-up of his mum, wiping a tear, smiling; the crowd cheers around her.
